notes: Positions are copied from the source paper. Table I prints half widths (HWHM); FWHM = 2 x HWHM.

The A1g and B1g(2) components are not resolved in the source, so their separate positions are left empty. When a spectrum resolves them, this project labels the lower-frequency line A1g and the higher one B1g(2) (Ohsaka et al. 1978 convention). The order is disputed: polarized single-crystal work by Giarola et al. 2010 (ANA068) assigns A1g to the higher line.
Eg(1) shifts up and broadens in nanocrystals (phonon confinement) and with doping; the project's anatase papers show Eg(1) from about 137 to 159 cm-1.
